1: YOU are Vetvel.  You are good, kind, loyal, thrifty, hard-working, loving, trustworthy, understanding, clever, vivacious, sympathetic, assiduous, friendly, clean, intelligent, and totally deserving of the Shepherdship --- right?
2: Kendra is a Klast female, 22 years old.  She is a very flighty person given to acting on the spur of the moment.  She very much wants to be liked, but has a nasty temper that often antagonizes people.  She has little loyalty to her friends, doesn't trust people, and isn't very trustworthy herself.
3: Gardbore is a Frem male, 43 years old.  He has been waiting for his chance to compete for the Shepherdship since Feslym became the Fourth Shepherd.  The years of waiting have not sat well with Gardbore; he is aloof and cynical.  A proud and intelligent person, Gardbore looks down on the other acolytes.  He really doesn't care what they think about him.  He is not very trustworthy, but he is loyal to those he considers his friends.  He is also very secretive.
4: Wiki is a Ripi male, just as Siboot was, 33 years old.  He is a happy-go-lucky fellow, always ready with a wry joke.  His talent for making puns across several languages strikes terror in the hearts of all who must endure his creations.  He has a strong sense of obligation to those who help him and a lot of personal integrity, although he finds it hard to have faith in other people.  He is not vain but he does have a bit of a temper.
5: Locksher is a Lokweel male, 28 years old.  He is a natural leader who exudes charisma.  He is widely respected throughout the colony.  He is good-hearted, loyal, honest, and gullible.  On the other hand, he has little sense of personal obligation to those who help him, and he doesn't share information easily.
6: Zubi is a Srol female, 27 years old.  She has a razor-sharp intelligence and is vivacious and charming.  Despite her many gifts, she is uncertain of herself and craves the approval of others.  She tries hard to please people and is quite gullible.  She is not at all vain but her actions are seldom guided by any sense of loyalty.
7: Skordokott is a Tayran male, 34 years old.  He is the quintessential Tayran, proud, stern, absolutely disciplined.  His sense of loyalty and duty to others is unshakable.  He is utterly contemptuous of what other people think of him.
8: Chris Crawford is a fine fellow, but he takes his game designs too seriously for his own good.  He actually called this game "my Holy Grail!"  Now that it's done and looks more like a rusty old beer can, he is having serious emotional problems adjusting to reality.  Oh, well, he can always do NUDE SPACE DEFENDERS FROM HELL.
